name: Runner Extras - Query Join Aggregation OOS
brief: Follow-up to issue #2137: a query column with Method = Sum/Count/Average/Min/Max used to silently return unaggregated, ungrouped rows instead of aggregating or throwing. This suite originally pinned the two surfaces that still could not aggregate correctly as loud RunnerOutOfScopeException throws; issue #2146 has since implemented both for real (a multi-dataitem JOIN query with an aggregated column, and a runtime SetFilter/SetRange on an aggregated column — a HAVING-clause filter), so the tests below now assert the correct aggregated/filtered answer instead of an expected throw.
description: The general BC-language claim these fixes make — a query with Method = Sum/Count/Average/Min/Max implicitly groups by its other (non-aggregated) columns and computes the aggregate per group, exactly like the SQL SELECT ... GROUP BY / HAVING the real service tier compiles, whether the query is single-dataitem or a multi-dataitem JOIN — is plain BC behaviour and belongs upstream in the al-language corpus (see the runner repo's bc-behavior-tests-go-upstream.md); an upstream corpus PR was prepared alongside the #2146 fix. This suite is INTERIM runner-repo-local coverage of the same shapes, kept alive until that corpus PR merges and the submodule pin moves — once it does, this suite is a candidate for trimming back down to whatever remains genuinely runner-specific (if anything).
